description: On the green tabletop in front of you, there’s a white AirPods case and a short white charging cable. The right hand holds the AirPods case steady on the right side while the left hand slides in from the left to pick up the cable end and guide it toward the case’s charging port; both hands briefly meet at the case as the left hand plugs the cable in, then the left hand lets go while the right hand keeps the case in place.
